epochs.name: Prehistoric Foundations & Age of Vanaras

epochs.name: Deep Antiquity
epochs.notes: Mythic age of Varunesh and Manjalaya, the Shadow Pact and the forging of the Dragon's Spine. Was in use on entities long before it was declared here.

epochs.name: Civilization Dawn (Lothal Era)
epochs.notes: Harappan city-states, Mask Family, Kia alliance, Tendua Crisis

epochs.name: Post-Cataclysmic Era (Possible Future)
epochs.notes: Survival Train of Varuna and Mitra. Setting of Varuna's Field Diary: the era is deliberately unwritten, so it is authored by the game rather than inherited. Previously marked 'not hard-locked'; choosing it means writing it.
